summary:
Final turn: the environment observation is confirmed in the clean copy and the run is closed with its remaining items enumerated.

What was confirmed. The listen exploration ran on the trusted runner (check f83012e7adef45afb5ac4c97b3095d5d) with the same result as the local construction run: socket creation is denied in this execution environment ("socket: operation not permitted" for both a loopback and an all-interfaces bind). That settles the environment class behind two earlier caveats — the startup-probe finding's fixed-address dial fails here for the same reason, and the attempt to measure the replica loop's startup phase could not keep a loop alive. Both statements now rest on the environment's own error rather than on a nil listener or a panic.

Where the run ends. Twelve claim families with executed artifacts: nine confirmed violations or consequences — C1 (a recovery ignores a reply reporting the instance COMMITTED and commits a NOOP vector for it, on a driven proposal/commit history), C3 (the same divergence reaching the applied state on that history), C2 (the durable metadata record loses the bal value), C4 (a legal NOOP commit terminates a restarted owner, on a constructed history), C6 (the promoted-leader variant of C1), C7 (the accept handler's rejection branch is unreachable), C9 (the recorder writes the recovering replica's own row's metadata), C10 (a value beyond the 16-bit length field is truncated, displaces the following commands, panics the receiver's decoder, and — as the exploration observed — makes the production peer reader exit), C11 (replica construction dereferences a failed probe dial), C12 (the documented transitive-conflict skipping is inert) — plus two bounded no-violation protections: C5 (an owner that survives a NOOP recovery re-proposes the operation and, per the executed artifact, answers the client end to end) and C8 (the executor timeout enqueues a blocked instance and the enqueued entry starts a real recovery). The map is current at version 20, every analysis-root file has been read, and earlier limitations were retired by later scenarios rather than left standing.

What remains and what each item needs. One semantic review to confirm the executed end-to-end client-reply artifact; unit and review capacity to fix the reader-side exit observation as a claim whose artifact observes it through a controlled expectation; deployment configurations that enable the latency file, durable recording or the transitive-skip flag, which decide whether three findings are live; two paused candidates with scoped resume conditions (accept-status semantics, client retry); and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact, which no accepted mechanism can resolve and which therefore stays permanently visible bookkeeping whose substance already lives in the amended claim and in C3. Throughout, no requirement was weakened, no history invented, and every inference boundary is labelled as such.
